confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking sites. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the better-grounded part; accommodation is least certain because rates vary by district and July beach-season demand. Cocktail and wine glass were set relative to the draft beer anchor because direct price knowledge is weaker. The USD figures depend on an approximate KRW-to-USD rate from general knowledge, not a live source.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single named comparable city was used. The basis is general South Korean price levels: Busan is set somewhat below Seoul for restaurants and lodging and in line with other large Korean regional cities for everyday food and drink. Accommodation reflects July peak-season demand in beach and central districts.

anchor_basis.beer: 500 ml draft lager at a neighborhood pub or restaurant, about 6,000 KRW
anchor_basis.coffee: cappuccino at an independent cafe in Seomyeon or Haeundae, about 5,800 KRW
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: dwaeji gukbap (pork and rice soup) at a local eatery, about 9,000 KRW
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: three-course set dinner for two at a mid-range Western-style restaurant, no drinks, about 100,000 KRW total
anchor_basis.cocktail: standard cocktail at a neighborhood bar, about 15,000 KRW (about 2.5 times the draft beer price)
anchor_basis.wine_glass: house wine by the glass at a casual wine bar, about 12,000 KRW (about twice the draft beer price)
anchor_basis.hostel_dorm_1p: shared dorm bed in a registered Haeundae or Nampo hostel in July, about 32,000 KRW per night
anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: private double room in a registered hostel or guesthouse in July, about 70,000 KRW per night
anchor_basis.hotel_1star_2p: basic double room at a registered budget motel (yeogwan), about 50,000 KRW per night
anchor_basis.hotel_3star_2p: double room at a registered three-star hotel in Haeundae or Seomyeon in July, about 170,000 KRW per night
